SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE TRUNC(created_at) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE) AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT role, COUNT(*) as count FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY role ORDER BY role

SELECT grade, COUNT(*) as count FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY grade ORDER BY CASE grade WHEN 'ECONOMY' THEN 1 WHEN 'STANDARD' THEN 2 WHEN 'BUSINESS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FIRST' THEN 4 WHEN 'ELITE' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

WITH gender_groups AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN gender = 'male' THEN '남성' WHEN gender = 'female' THEN '여성' ELSE '미설정' END as gender, CASE WHEN gender = 'male' THEN 1 WHEN gender = 'female' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END as sort_order FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ) SELECT gender, COUNT(*) as count FROM gender_groups GROUP BY gender, sort_order ORDER BY sort_order

WITH age_groups AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN '미설정' WHEN age BETWEEN 10 AND 19 THEN '10대' WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20대' WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30대' WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40대' WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50대' WHEN age >= 60 THEN '60대 이상' ELSE '기타' END as ageGroup, CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN 8 WHEN age BETWEEN 10 AND 19 THEN 1 WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN 2 WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN 3 WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN 4 WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN 5 WHEN age >= 60 THEN 6 ELSE 7 END as sort_order FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ) SELECT ageGroup, COUNT(*) as count FROM age_groups GROUP BY ageGroup, sort_order ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND ( age >= 65 OR disease = 'true' OR disability = 'true' OR medication = 'true' )

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(created_at, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM') as month, COUNT(*) as count FROM users WHERE created_at >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -11) AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY TRUNC(created_at, 'MM') ORDER BY TRUNC(created_at, 'MM')
